rubrics.justification: It appropriately states that no image/Gardner score was provided and avoids inventing specific morphology, but therefore does not deliver an actual morphological analysis.
It integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, endometrium, sperm, diagnosis, and cycle context well with prognosis, though some links to embryo-specific quality are necessarily indirect.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with probability estimates tied to age, endometrium, and assumed embryo quality; minor overinterpretation exists around alcohol/stress effects and expected blastocyst numbers.

Much is broadly IVF-consistent, but some recommendations are weakly evidence-based or not routinely guideline-supported (ERA, thrombophilia/NK testing, acupuncture, routine estradiol addition, broad protocol speculation).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer monitoring, luteal support, and future-cycle considerations, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard-of-care.
